subject: Private/Dedicated isolation — evidence handoff & checklist
messages:
From: Julia Perez <julia.perez@clearwater-systems.com>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 21 Jun 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Evidence request: private/dedicated isolation for SOC 2 review

Sean —

Thanks for the quick intro last week. Our SOC 2 audit team is kicking off a network and isolation review for vendors, and Clearwater needs a compact packet from Redwood covering the Private and Dedicated deployment isolation model. At a minimum we need:

- Network diagrams for Private and Dedicated (annotated flows showing control plane vs data plane)
- A short narrative (1–2 pages) describing tenant separation guarantees and enforcement points
- Proof artifacts: ACL examples, segmentation rules, and a mapping of control owners
- Any evidence you can provide for automated prefix/KV cache isolation and fallback routing logic relevant to isolation claims

Can you confirm what you can deliver by June 30? Also: do you have any standard SOC 2 indexing you prefer (SIG/CAIQ crosswalk, etc.) so we can slot your packet into our evidence binder?

Appreciate it — we will share the auditor contact once we receive the packet.

Julia Perez
Security Program Manager
Clearwater Systems
_julia.perez@clearwater-systems.com_

From: Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.ai>
To: Julia Perez <julia.perez@clearwater-systems.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 21 Jun 2026 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Evidence request: private/dedicated isolation for SOC 2 review

Julia —

Thanks — we can put together a concise packet that covers everything you listed. High-level deliverables we propose:

1) Annotated network diagrams (Private / Dedicated) in PDF, plus a layered PNG for quick review
2) 2-page narrative describing tenant fencing, control plane partitioning, egress controls and KMS boundary assumptions
3) Segmentation checklist (spreadsheet) mapping evidence to SIG/CAIQ control IDs
4) ACL snippets, sample network policies (cloud-specific), and a short runbook excerpt describing tenant eviction and emergency isolation steps

We can also include a short statement on automatic fallback behavior (model variant routing) so the auditor can see how graceful degradation does/does not affect isolation guarantees.

Before we start: two quick clarifying Qs —
- Do you need HSM/KMS attestation detail (we can include KMS key policy excerpts and envelope encryption description)
- Is the auditor OK with redacted internal IPs? we typically provide CIDR ranges plus redacted examples rather than host-level addresses.

Looping in Kimberly and Ben to pick owners for diagrams and the runbook excerpt.

Action: I will upload a draft checklist and a placeholder diagram to a shared Drive link by EOD today. Final packet target: 2026-06-30 (or earlier if auditor needs).

Sean Gallagher
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
_sean_gallagher@redwood.ai_

Attachments: segmentation-checklist.xlsx (stub), isolation-diagram-v1.pdf (stub)

From: Julia Perez <julia.perez@clearwater-systems.com>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 21 Jun 2026 14:27:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Evidence request: private/dedicated isolation for SOC 2 review

On Mon, Jun 21, 2026 at 10:03 AM Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.ai> wrote:
> Julia —
> 
> Thanks — we can put together a concise packet that covers everything you listed. High-level deliverables we propose: ...

Thanks Sean — that scope looks good. A few auditor-specific asks to bake into the packet if possible:

- Please include an explicit table called "Per-tenant egress controls" listing allowed egress destinations and whether DNS/URL filtering is enforced per-tenant or at platform-level.
- If you can include a sample ACL snippet showing the deny/allow precedence that would be very helpful for our infra auditor.
- For the diagrams: please annotate control plane endpoints with roles (orchestration, monitoring, key management) and indicate which ones live in the private control plane vs managed control plane.

Redaction is fine; we prefer CIDR ranges and example ACLs. KMS detail is optional but helpful — if you include key policy excerpts, please mark them as "auditor-only" and we can handle secure sharing.

We will plan to have the auditor review the packet the week of July 6; earlier is welcome.

Julia

Attachments: auditor-scope-note.pdf (for internal ref)

From: Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.ai>
